method: READ-ONLY audit (security subagent + ops subagent) at RC1

items.finding: /api/authorities/usage/* and /endpoints/* are global registries with no owner dimension; any authenticated tenant could read/modify them
no admin role/gate existed for global resources
project_id is a free string used as an authority key on bindings/continuity; no path/format validation
items.action_taken: D7-B validate_project_id + tests (no second project model)

items.finding: D6 new surfaces had labels/roles; no repo-wide audit; paid actions needed explicit wording
items.action_taken: D7-C DOM/ARIA contract tests + explicit paid-action hint

items.finding: cftunnel stack runs API only; no worker/scheduler service; scheduler_required default true means queued tasks may not dequeue absent systemd units
items.action_taken: documented in D7-L/N operator contract; not code-changed (deployment topology, out of product scope)

items.finding: differentiation SQLite stores migrate implicitly with schema_version guard; no downgrade
items.action_taken: D7-F RC1->RC2 forward-migration test (data preserved, idempotent)

items.finding: existing backup.sh covers only PostgreSQL+MinIO, not the data/ authority stores; store_backup.py had no operational caller
reconcile_on_startup is report-only; worker not started by cftunnel API lifespan
items.action_taken: ACCEPTED_LIMITATION documented (single-host operator must run worker/scheduler)

items.finding: QueueWorker.stop() does not drain/cancel in-flight task
items.action_taken: ACCEPTED_LIMITATION documented; durable resume covers restart

items.finding: /api/health/ready checked PostgreSQL only; no authority-store/host-claim checks; no degraded signal
redact_secrets was not a logging filter
TraceContext had no request_id/run_id/incident_id; no response correlation header
no real-browser E2E harness in this environment (no Playwright/a browser)
items.action_taken: D7-K specs provided; NOT EXECUTED here

items.finding: metrics endpoint unauthenticated; most logs unstructured
items.action_taken: ACCEPTED_LIMITATION (metrics endpoint is internal-network operational surface)

items.finding: authorities usage/endpoints data classes are inherently global (no owner column)
items.action_taken: D7-A admin-only; a per-tenant ledger is a future feature, not RC2
